phase: ROADMAP Stage 5 backfill: GATED BM25 sweep calibration SCAFFOLD v1. The original 'calibrate BM25 k1/b on the real query set via CLI' item remains UNCHECKED — no ready_real set exists and no real calibration was run; only the readiness-gated scaffold is delivered.
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only BM25 sweep calibration scaffold that is HARD-GATED on summarize_real_query_readiness(dataset).status == 'ready_real'. build_bm25_sweep_grid/validate_bm25_sweep_config build and check a small (k1,b,threshold) grid. run_bm25_sweep_on_real_query_set refuses any template/incomplete/synthetic/invalid set, and also refuses a ready_real set that lacks a 'corpus'; only when both gates pass does it run a deterministic sweep (reusing the existing isolated-DB evaluate_retrieval harness), reporting per-combination title/chunk recall + MRR + miss and selecting the best by recall then fewest misses. A CLI tools/sweep_bm25_real_queries.py exits nonzero unless a real calibration actually ran. No real calibration result is fabricated; the original ROADMAP item stays unchecked with a checked sub-note for the scaffold.
implemented: backend/server.py: build_bm25_sweep_grid(options=None) (cleans/dedups/sorts k1>=0, 0<=b<=1, threshold>=0; reports combination_count).

backend/server.py: run_bm25_sweep_on_real_query_set(dataset, config=None) hard-gated on readiness=='ready_real' AND presence of a corpus; refuses otherwise without running; on pass, runs a deterministic (k1,b) sweep via run_retrieval_eval_suite, records threshold candidates, and selects best by (title_recall, chunk_recall, -miss, ...).
tools/sweep_bm25_real_queries.py: CLI (--set/--json); exit 0 only when a sweep actually ran, 1 when refused, 2 on load error; no network/model call.

tests/test_bm25_real_sweep.py: 12 tests (grid determinism/override-cleaning/invalid-grid; gate refuses template/incomplete/no-corpus/synthetic; ready_real+corpus runs 36-combo deterministic sweep with metric fields; decision determinism; JSON serializable; CLI refuses template nonzero and runs on an in-memory ready_real set).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_bm25_real_sweep.py and tools/sweep_bm25_real_queries.py.
README.md documents the gated scaffold and its honesty boundary; docs/ROADMAP.md keeps the original BM25-calibration item UNCHECKED and adds a checked sub-note for the guarded scaffold only.

risks: The sweep result's title_mrr can jitter across runs on documents with tied retrieval scores (tie-break ordering in the retrieval layer across fresh temp DBs); the calibration DECISION fields (k1/b/threshold, recall, miss_count) are deterministic and MRR is excluded from best-selection, but MRR should not be treated as bit-stable.

The scaffold reuses run_retrieval_eval_suite which imports the corpus into a throwaway SQLite DB per (k1,b); a large real corpus will make the full grid slow (it is a calibration tool, not a hot path).
Threshold values are swept and reported but not yet wired as an enforced score cut-off in search; applying them is a deliberate later step.
Gate correctness depends on summarize_real_query_readiness; if that classifier is loosened, this gate loosens with it — they are intentionally coupled.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
